installed_version_interpretation: Source-declared pins from inventory.json, not verified image/package manifests or observed runtime versions.
scope: Eight upstream tools. Stable GitHub releases newer than declared pins; default-branch commits since installed tag when no newer release exists. Primary project sources only.
coverage_limit: Release notes and bounded source comparisons can establish known fixes but cannot establish that software or the pipeline is bug-free. No modules were updated; no cloud action or pipeline run performed by this audit.

tools.assessment: Newer release found, but its release notes describe deterministic -d reporting and runtime AVX selection, not a concrete post-2.5.4 correctness fix. The pipeline does not pass -d, -a or -k in its normal configuration.
tools.limit: Source/release/commit scan only; no binary/image resolved, upgrade executed, biological impact reproduced or exhaustive absence of bugs established.

tools.assessment: No newer release. Default branch labels itself 0.3.3 but no release/tag replacing v0.3.2 was found in the release scan. One merged barcode-summary correctness fix is outside the bulk SAM pipeline's normal branch.

known_post_version_fixes.summary: Include uncorrected/non-whitelist barcode reads in single-cell summary totals
known_post_version_fixes.detail: Patch is in the !is_bulk_data branch and requires summary metadata. This pipeline supplies no barcodes/whitelist and emits SAM. Changes to pairs-format MAPQ fields are also not its output path.

tools.assessment: 4.0.0 is a major backend rewrite, not a small patch update. Several reported fixes/change boundaries are relevant to used commands; no affected dataset was executed here.

known_post_version_fixes.summary: Correct computeMatrix BED blockstart output and chromosome-boundary handling with --missingDataAsZero
known_post_version_fixes.detail: Both computeMatrix modes explicitly use --missingDataAsZero. Regions exceeding chromosome bounds may therefore produce different bins; exact ATAC impact unmeasured.

known_post_version_fixes.summary: AlignmentSieve preserves input order; rewritten tools apply blacklist filtering at base-pair resolution
known_post_version_fixes.detail: alignmentSieve is used for ATAC shifting, but this workflow sorts its output afterward. Blacklist semantics matter only for applicable options/input; new matrix numerical precision also differs (f32/f64), so equality is not promised.

known_post_version_fixes.summary: Correct --nanAfterEnd reference-point scaling and plotPCA option handling
known_post_version_fixes.detail: The current configuration does not pass --nanAfterEnd and does not call plotPCA. Other tools' removed bamCoverage/bamCompare options are not automatically relevant to the used modules.

tools.assessment: 3.5.0 contains a relevant optical-duplicate coordinate-width fix and a flow-specific fix that the standard Illumina pipeline does not enable. It also changes the HTSJDK dependency/CRAM defaults.

known_post_version_fixes.summary: Use int instead of short for physical locations, preventing overflow and inaccurate duplicate handling on larger flowcells
known_post_version_fixes.detail: MarkDuplicates is used and normal config does not disable optical-duplicate parsing. Candidate effect is optical-duplicate classification/metrics for sufficiently large read-name coordinates; no BAM/peak/count effect has been reproduced.

known_post_version_fixes.summary: Correct spill-to-disk handling of significant read ends in flow-base duplicate marking
known_post_version_fixes.detail: The pipeline does not enable flow-specific MarkDuplicates options. Do not conflate this with the general optical-coordinate overflow fix.

tools.assessment: 3.0.5 and 3.1.0 are newer. Most prominently documented numerical fixes are gated off by normal ATAC options or unreachable today; robustness fixes and a large performance/backend change remain relevant. No default scientific-output regression is established by this scan.

known_post_version_fixes.summary: Fix multi-summit gap-score attribution, boundary candidate loss and shape clipping
known_post_version_fixes.detail: All three upstream reports require call_summits=True/--call-summits. This pipeline does not normally pass --call-summits; a user override could make them relevant.

known_post_version_fixes.summary: Filter a control with its own automatically calculated duplicate threshold
known_post_version_fixes.detail: Upstream explicitly states behavior is unchanged for --keep-dup all, which both ATAC callpeak configurations set.

known_post_version_fixes.summary: Restore k=0 in large-lambda lower-tail Poisson CDF
known_post_version_fixes.detail: The merged PR says no reported number changes today and no current command reaches that function. Do not claim this repairs this pipeline's p-values.

known_post_version_fixes.summary: Reject truncated BAM alignment records and improve worker failure/concurrency cleanup
known_post_version_fixes.detail: BAM/BAMPE peak calling is used. This concerns malformed inputs or worker failures; no effect on valid current HIV data is demonstrated. Both new releases require Python >=3.12 and 3.1.0 adds CPU/backend controls.

tools.assessment: Latest release/tag remains 3.2.0. All 192 post-tag default-branch commit subjects were scanned across two compare pages; selected fix patches and old-tag code were inspected. Most findings are in an unreleased substantial reader/dispatcher rewrite; applicability to installed 3.2.0 is not established.

known_post_version_fixes.summary: Repair mapped-read checks, BAM interval/queue handling, mate comparisons and subcommand argument dispatch in the development rewrite
known_post_version_fixes.detail: v3.2.0 uses SAMReader_deprecated with explicit is_primary && is_mapped checks; the inspected mapped-read fix touches the later bamxx reader. The dispatcher also changed in the rewrite. A post-tag bugfix title alone does not show the tagged binary contains that bug.

known_post_version_fixes.summary: Update Jinja2 requirements to address a vulnerability
known_post_version_fixes.detail: Both patches modify documentation/docs/requirements.txt, not the preseq runtime used for lc_extrap.

tools.assessment: 0.12.9 is newer and explicitly repairs small-buffer overflow while parsing large GFF fields. This is a relevant optional annotation-input branch, not evidence that the current run's annotation triggers it.

known_post_version_fixes.summary: Fix small-buffer overflow parsing large GFF fields
known_post_version_fixes.detail: PREPARE_GENOME invokes gffread when a GFF is supplied instead of a ready GTF. Field-size trigger and impact need a separate reproduction; current full-HIV runs were not altered.
